Terms of Use — SolviPath

Last updated: November 22, 2026. By creating an account or using SolviPath you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

1. Who we are

SolviPath (www.solvipath.com) is a service of FixRight Home Renovations LLC, a limited liability company organized in the State of Georgia, United States. In these terms, "we" means that company and "you" means the person using the app.

2. What SolviPath is

SolviPath is a tool to organize your debts, compare payoff methods (snowball and avalanche), track fixed expenses and receive reminders. It works as an installable web app and, later, as an app in app stores.

3. Not financial advice

  • Calculations, projections and comparisons are estimates based on the data you enter. They may differ from what your bank or lender charges.
  • We are not financial, legal, tax or investment advisors, and nothing in the app is personalized advice.
  • We do not lend money, process payments or connect to your bank accounts. You make payments to your creditors yourself.
  • Exchange rates (TRM and euro) are informational and may be delayed.
  • You decide what to do with your money. For important decisions, consult a professional.

4. Your account

  • You must be at least 18 years old.
  • You must provide a valid email and keep your password secret. You are responsible for activity on your account.
  • You can use the app without an account; in that case your data stays only on your device and is lost if you clear browser data or uninstall.
  • You can delete your account at any time (see Privacy Policy, section 8).

5. Acceptable use

You may not: use the app for illegal purposes; try to access other users' data; interfere with or attempt to breach the service; reverse engineer, copy or resell the app; or send offensive or malicious content in suggestions. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

6. Your data and our content

Your data is yours. You give us a limited permission to store and process it only to provide the service, as explained in the Privacy Policy. SolviPath, its name, logo, design and code belong to FixRight Home Renovations LLC or its licensors; we grant you a personal, limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the app. We may use the suggestions you send to improve the service without paying you.

7. Availability and changes

We try to keep the app working well, but it is provided "as is" and "as available": there may be interruptions, errors or maintenance. We may change, add or remove features. If we ever charge for features, we will tell you first and will not charge you without your acceptance.

8. Advertising and membership

SolviPath is free to use, with optional paid features.

  • The app may show ads from third parties (for example Google AdMob). These providers may use advertising identifiers of your device to show and measure ads.
  • We will inform you and ask for your consent where the law requires it.
  • There is an optional paid membership that removes ads.
  • Payments are processed by Google Play; SolviPath does not store card data.
  • The conditions and the price are shown before you buy.
  • You can cancel the membership from Google Play.

9. Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect losses, lost profits, or damages from financial decisions you make based on the app, or for data loss caused by failures beyond our control. If we are liable, our total liability is limited to what you paid for the app in the previous 12 months or US$100, whichever is greater. Nothing here limits rights that the law does not allow to be limited, such as consumer rights in Colombia or the European Union.

10. Termination

You may stop using the app and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or close your account if you breach these terms or for legal or security reasons.

11. Governing law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Georgia, United States, without regard to its conflict-of-law rules. Disputes will be resolved in the courts of Georgia. If you are a consumer in Colombia or the European Union, you keep the mandatory rights of your country, including the right to go to local authorities or courts.

We may update them. For important changes, we will notify you in the app or by email before they apply. If you keep using SolviPath afterwards, you are treated as accepting them.

13. Contact

SolviPath (www.solvipath.com) es un servicio de FixRight Home Renovations LLC, sociedad de responsabilidad limitada constituida en el estado de Georgia, Estados Unidos. En estos términos, "nosotros" es esa empresa y "tú" es la persona que usa la app.

SolviPath es una herramienta para organizar tus deudas, comparar métodos de pago (bola de nieve y avalancha), llevar tus gastos fijos y recibir recordatorios. Funciona como aplicación web instalable y, más adelante, como app en tiendas de aplicaciones.
